concerns.text: T004 and T009 both require `code/utils/verify_pii_removal.py` to pass, but no task in T001–T010 creates or implements that script. Plan.md's T-031b described it, but the consolidated re-plan dropped it without folding its implementation into any task, leaving a dangling dependency for the PII-verification requirement (spec edge case on anonymization, constitution Principle VI).

The dropout edge case requires 'partial data from dropouts to be excluded from paired analyses.' T004 writes `dropout_flags.json`, but T005's analysis pipeline only mentions outlier exclusion (>30 min, ≥2 outliers) and missing-ground-truth exclusions — no task applies the dropout flags to exclude incomplete participants from the paired McNemar/LME analyses. The edge case is flagged but never enforced anywhere in the task list.
